# Security Policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

Report suspected formula, cask, checksum, download-source, or update-channel
vulnerabilities through GitHub's private vulnerability reporting for this
repository. Do not open a public issue with exploit details or sensitive
diagnostics.

Include the package name and version, observed digest, expected digest,
verification output, potential impact, and a safe reproduction. You can expect
an initial response within seven days. Fix and disclosure timelines depend on
severity and exploitability.

If a downloaded archive does not match the package SHA-256, do not install or
run it.

## Supported packages

The current formula and cask versions on `main` are supported during active
development.
